name: Copper/Gold ROC Quartile Sort → SPY 63d Forward Returns
description: Quartile-sorts the 63-day rate of change of the copper/gold ratio (HG/GC) using a 252-day rolling percentrank. Analyzes SPY 63-day forward returns by quartile (Q1=most falling, Q4=most rising). Shows median return per quartile (bar chart), return distribution by quartile (boxplot), and a stats table (N, median, hit rate, best, worst per quartile).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD ROC QUARTILE SORT → SPY 63D FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Signal: 63-day ROC of the copper/gold futures ratio (HG/GC)
#   Q1 = bottom 25% (ratio falling fastest)
#   Q4 = top 25%    (ratio rising fastest)
# Question: Does extreme rising copper/gold (Q4) give meaningfully better
#           SPY returns than extreme falling (Q1)?
#
# Methodology:
#   - HG and GC: NoAdjustment (preserves true ratio across roll dates, D16)
#   - percentrank(period=252) for stable quartile boundaries
#   - forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close) for SPY 63d forward price return
#   - Hit rate via ternary 1.0/0.0 (S29 — NOT where(cond, 1.0))
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary asset: SPY ---
spy_src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
spy_close = spy_src.c

# --- Reference futures: Copper (HG) and Gold (GC) ---
# NoAdjustment preserves true price ratio across roll dates (D16)
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# Forward-fill to handle any calendar gaps in shared-context data (S42)
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- Copper/Gold ratio and 63-day ROC ---
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
cg_roc = roc(period=63)(cg_ratio)

# --- Quartile bucketing via 252-day rolling percentrank ---
# percentrank returns 0-100; quartile thresholds at 25/50/75
cg_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(cg_roc)

# Map to quartile label (1=Q1 bottom, 4=Q4 top)
# Guard with is_valid to handle NaN during warmup (S02)
quartile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 25,  1.0,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 50,  2.0,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 75,  3.0,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 100, 4.0,
    0.0
)

# Quartile label as string for boxplot grouped mode
quartile_label = conditional_select(
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 25,  'Q1 (Falling)',
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 50,  'Q2',
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 75,  'Q3',
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 100, 'Q4 (Rising)',
    'N/A'
)

# --- SPY 63-day forward return (price series — safe for forward_returns, S46) ---
spy_fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# --- Per-quartile forward returns (NaN outside quartile) ---
fwd_q1 = where(is_valid(quartile) and quartile == 1.0, spy_fwd_63d)
fwd_q2 = where(is_valid(quartile) and quartile == 2.0, spy_fwd_63d)
fwd_q3 = where(is_valid(quartile) and quartile == 3.0, spy_fwd_63d)
fwd_q4 = where(is_valid(quartile) and quartile == 4.0, spy_fwd_63d)

# --- Hit rate: 1.0 if positive return, 0.0 if not (S29 — ternary, NOT where) ---
hit_q1 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q1) and fwd_q1 > 0) else 0.0
hit_q2 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q2) and fwd_q2 > 0) else 0.0
hit_q3 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q3) and fwd_q3 > 0) else 0.0
hit_q4 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q4) and fwd_q4 > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1: Median 63d SPY return by quartile (the punchline) ---
# Grouped mode: each BarSeriesSpec = one quartile, stack = x-axis category
# Using series mode with stack so Q1-Q4 appear as x-axis categories
xy_bars(
    title='Does Rising Copper/Gold Predict Better SPY Returns?',
    category='Copper/Gold Signal',
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Median 63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median Return', stack='Q1 (Falling)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median Return', stack='Q2', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median Return', stack='Q3', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Median Return', stack='Q4 (Rising)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4)

# --- Chart 2: Return distribution by quartile (boxplot, grouped mode) ---
boxplot(
    title='SPY 63d Return Distribution: Q1 vs Q4 Tells the Story',
    category='Copper/Gold Signal',
    y_axis_label='63d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.median:.1%}',
    colors=[Color.Red, Color.Gray, Color.Sky, Color.Blue],
    median_color=Color.White,
    median_width=2,
    order=2
)(label=quartile_label, values=spy_fwd_63d)

# --- Table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per quartile (LAST) ---
# Standard mode: 5 rows × 4 columns = 20 cells
# Rows: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst
# Cols: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY 63d Forward Returns by Copper/Gold ROC Quartile',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (Obs)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Q1 (Falling)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Rising)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N (count of observations per quartile)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            # Row 1: Median return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (mean of 0/1 flags = fraction positive)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best (max return)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 4: Worst (min return)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper/Gold Signal',
    order=0
)(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4)
